paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS UPC PbPb light-by-light scattering analysis sets 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma = 1/Lambda vs m_a (5-90 GeV), best limits over m_a = 5-50 GeV. The exclusion is presented graphically in Fig. 7 (and cross section limits in Fig. 6, 1500-20 nb), but no numerical table of (m_a, g_agamma) points is given in the text. The y-axis is g_agamma in GeV^-1, hence AxionPhoton. Cannot extract reliable numerical data points from the figures alone.
